Thought of a couple more issues. You can override the server name on the CLI with `--server`. For parity, this should also be overrideable. 

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/8577711b61cd768df723c6dac333743159393d23/staging/src/k8s.io/cli-runtime/pkg/genericclioptions/config_flags.go#L43-L44
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/8577711b61cd768df723c6dac333743159393d23/staging/src/k8s.io/cli-runtime/pkg/genericclioptions/config_flags.go#L159-L168
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/8577711b61cd768df723c6dac333743159393d23/staging/src/k8s.io/cli-runtime/pkg/genericclioptions/config_flags.go#L294-L299

When overriding the server on the CLI, I would expect the server verify name to be overridden as well. This is similar to how overriding the insecure or CA settings on the CLI overrides all the trust settings (insecure/ca-file/ca-data) together:

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/8577711b61cd768df723c6dac333743159393d23/staging/src/k8s.io/client-go/tools/clientcmd/client_config.go#L452-L461

issue_context.title: Support TLS Server Name overrides in kubeconfig file
issue_context.body:
We are using multiple AWS EKS deployed clusters with private VPC-only access in combination with VPC-peering and tooling to provide multiple environments.

Currently, we deploy intermediary proxies to get round the limitation in EKS that the API servers are only routable from within the same VPC.

To establish a connection from another location, we have to include a `hosts` file override to point to the proxy because the TLS SNI is not separately configured from the address resolution.

Would be great to have this added to the code here: https://github.com/kubernetes/client-go/blob/master/tools/clientcmd/api/types.go.

Is this really the only place in this package that needs to change? E.g., what about getCluster() elsewhere in the file?

Yes, couldn't find any other place I need to modify.
(and e2e tests didn't show any failures ...)

`getCluster` seems to just reset the CA data when insecure flag is set.
should specifying a server name clear TLSServerName, similar to how insecureSkipTLSVerify and CA interact?

```suggestion
	if config.overrides.ClusterInfo.TLSServerName != "" || config.overrides.ClusterInfo.Server != "" {
```

since tls server name defaults to server, I would expect setting Server and TLSServerName in the overrides to be paired. for example, if I have a kubeconfig that has this:
```
tlsServerName: https://example.com
server: https://1.2.3.4
```
and I override `--server https://foo.com`, I would expect `foo.com` to be used to verify the server unless I also override `--tls-server-name https://example.com`
